children: Reform UK received a second 36 million pound donation within 48 hours, according to the Daily Telegraph. According to ChainCatcher, crypto billionaire Christopher Harborne added the same amount donated by Ben Delo on Friday, bringing the party's total fundraising over the two days to 72 million pounds.
The party has raised more than 86 million pounds this year, far above the Conservatives' 10.2 million pounds and Labour's 7.7 million pounds.

title: Reform UK Receives Second 36 Million Pound Donation in 48 Hours
